group_ids.title: Group Ids
group_ids.description: Ids of groups that the invite link will give express access to.

weekly_distributes.title: Weekly Distributes
weekly_distributes.description: Number of times express access can be used per week. If None, express access has no limit.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Date and time when the invite link will expire.Default is 7 days from now.This is also the maximum expiry date allowed.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email to send the invite link to. If None, no email will be sent.

message.title: Message
message.description: Message to send with the email. If None, no message will be sent.
